acf.excerpt: The personal exploits of a 16 year old girl, her family and friends in Northern Ireland during the Troubles in the early 90s.
acf.lezshows_worthit_details: The show pulls off being a brilliant comedy while maintaining a realistic portrayal of troubled times.
acf.lezshows_plots:
The lesbian reveal is not until the last episode of season one.

Lousia Harland (who plays Orla McCool) played Orla as non-binary, but that has not been canonically confirmed.
acf.lezshows_episodes: • Season 1, Episode 6 - "Episode Six" Erin becomes the new editor of the school newspaper, and while desperate for a decent story to publish, raids the "Searching for Myself" writing contest entries and finds a student coming out story. She publishes it as "The Secret Life of a Lesbian" - despite Sister Michael forbidding her to. It turns out a member of Erin's core group of friends wrote the entry.
